items.title: Labor Party retains power in South Australia
items.description: The Labor Party has been re-elected in South Australia, while One Nation appears to have achieved its best electoral result anywhere in the country in nearly 30 years.

items.title: From a 'mountain to climb' to over a cliff, SA Liberals face total wipeout
items.description: Ashton Hurn said she had a "mountain to climb" when she took on the role of SA Liberal leader late last year. Now, the party's primary vote has fallen off a cliff, a result sure to see Liberals around the country asking why.

items.title: How are the results tracking in your SA electorate? Take a look at the map
items.description: Explore the results across metropolitan Adelaide and regional South Australia with these maps as votes continue to be counted.

items.title: Albanese government's 'no need to panic buy' messaging fails to land
items.description: As costs soar, queues form and regional bowsers run dry, the government must ensure its talking points are not detached from the incentives people are actually responding to.

items.title: Rhoda Roberts, the woman behind 'Welcome to Country', dies at 66
items.description: Rhoda Roberts AO, the arts executive who had an enduring impact on the cultural life of this country, has died. The Widjabul Wieybal woman was the creative force behind Australia's best-loved festivals and helped bring Welcomes to Country to the modern era.

items.title: Live: G7 vows action to protect energy supplies, condemns Iran attacks
items.description: G7 foreign ministers say they are prepared to take action to protect global energy supplies, stressing the need to keep key shipping routes — including the Strait of Hormuz — secure. Follow live.

items.title: Three sailors remain missing near Iran. Their families are hoping for a 'miracle'
items.description: Three people are unaccounted for after a merchant ship, trying to escape the war zone via the Strait of Hormuz, was bombed by Iran. Their loved ones are hoping against hope.

items.title: It's February 2020 all over again, but this time one man can end it
items.description: Though few Australians recognise it, our economic institutions have an exceptional track record of making good decisions in a crisis, but the uncertainty of Trump's war is a new type of challenge.

items.title: What is stagflation and what can we do about it?
items.description: As the Iran war dries up oil and gas supplies, should we prepare for stagflation?

items.title: These two dads say Australia needs to talk about compensating surrogates
items.description: Blind spots in surrogacy laws have been pushing desperate Australians overseas to get a baby, which comes with its own risks. Is it time to change our views on paying for surrogacy?

items.title: 'Brave' Matildas fall agonisingly short in heroic defeat against Japan
items.description: The Matildas have fallen to a heartbreaking Women's Asian Cup final defeat, losing 1-0 to Japan despite relentless pressure in the final quarter of the match.

items.title: Teen charged after 14 women allegedly assaulted while exercising in Perth
items.description: Police charge a teenager after he allegedly assaulted 14 women while they were exercising in Perth's northern suburbs.

items.title: These kids beat cancer, but treatments caused long-term health issues
items.description: Maya and Angus both survived childhood cancer, but the treatments that saved their lives left them with chronic health issues. Experts say better care is needed for childhood cancer survivors.

items.title: What country Victoria revealed about my Chinese grandfather's secret past
items.description: Genealogy is an addictive hobby but unlocking family secrets — and dealing with the fallout — can change your life.

items.title: What experts say is likely to happen to Australia's fuel supply from mid-April
items.description: The government is responding to fuel shortages due to the war in the Middle East and says Australia has enough supply until mid-April. Here's what experts say could happen after that.

items.title: Woman hurt in tractor accident at Queensland music event
items.description: The accident happened near Ipswich at CMC Rocks, which bills itself as the premier country music festival in Australia.

items.title: New games for an old console: Meet the new generation of Game Boy developers
items.description: A small community of game developers is releasing new games for Nintendo's decades-old video game console, harnessing the nostalgia of these classic devices.

items.title: From the salon to the sheds: How Brittnee found her passion in shearing
items.description: These women have found a community in an unlikely place — the male-dominated shearing sheds. From wool-classers to rouseabouts, this is how they play their vital part.

items.title: Why Ryan Gosling's eyes were so important to Project Hail Mary
items.description: With most of Project Hail Mary's action taking place in far off corners of space it was up to Australian cinematographer Greig Fraser to create what we've never seen.

items.title: Dockers much too strong for Dees, Petracca hurt in Suns' win over Tigers
items.description: Fremantle overpowers Melbourne for its first win of the season, Christian Petracca does a hamstring in Gold Coast's beating of Richmond and St Kilda hangs on grimly to beat GWS.

items.title: Tigers halves pair set for scans after limping off in loss to Rabbitohs
items.description: Wests Tigers captain Jarome Luai is expected to be out of action for several weeks, while his halves partner is also in doubt after the duo limped off during their 20-16 loss to South Sydney.

items.title: Where Australians are spending their money
items.description: As the cost-of-living crisis intensifies, people from all walks of life are struggling. ABC Your Say asked ordinary Australians how they were making ends meet.

items.title: Ash was hacked. She wants you to know 'you could be next'
items.description: In a matter of minutes, Ash Raso lost access to everything from her email address to her social media accounts and even banking. She is among a growing number of younger Australians falling victim to cybercrime.

items.title: Buffy The Vampire Slayer star Nicholas Brendon dies at 54
items.description: Nicholas Brendon, best known for his role as Xander Harris in all seven seasons of Buffy the Vampire Slayer, has died aged 54.

items.title: Federal politics is about to become all about the gas industry
items.description: Scott Morrison's assertion that the chase to secure vaccines in early 2021 was "not a race" cost him dearly. A similar global contest is already underway, only this time it involves securing energy supplies.
